portInfo.description: The Ports of Faxaflói (Faxaflóahafnir) handle Iceland’s capital-area cruise calls at Reykjavík and Akranes. Captured facility pages state all passenger-ship areas are ISPS-certified, fenced, and staffed with security while ships are alongside. A new two-floor, 5,500 m² multi-purpose passenger terminal is scheduled to open in spring 2026 to replace limited temporary facilities and grow turnaround traffic. The port participates in EPI environmental incentives. Quay-by-quay LOA and door coordinates were not on the captured English cruise pages, so pins stay null.
